Name: Silo Report
Author: bogie5464
Description:
I hate walking to my silos to see how much hay is left. So I fixed that. Every morning you wake up with a customizable notification of how much hay you have left in the silos. It can be set to a UI notification (Default) or a chat message to display to the server.

GitHub: [url=https://github.com/bogie5464/SiloReport]https://github.com/bogie5464/SiloReport[/url]

Customize instructions:

In config.json change the values after the colon of "notificationMode" to "ChatMode" to have it displayed over chat or "UIMode" to have a HUD display.
"checkMasterPlayer" shouldn't be messed with unless you know what you're doing. This prevents servers who have multiple people with this mod installed from spamming the chat.

Manifest.Name: SiloReport
Manifest.Description: Daily report in chat of how much hay left
